S, THIS DAY, ORDER

WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:15163  CRL.P No. 354 of 2025  ORAL ORDER Accused No.2 in Spl.C.No.109/2024 pending before the Court of Principal District and Session Judge, Madikeri, Kodagu District, arising out of Crime No.105/2024 registered by Gonikoppa Police Station, Kodagu, for offences punishable under Section 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code (for short, 'IPC') is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.PC seeking regular bail.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3. FIR in Crime No.105/2024 was registered by Gonikoppa Police Station, Kodagu, for the aforesaid offences against Rahul Chakrapani and others on the basis of the first information dated 04.10.2024 received from the Bhavya M.R., who was the employee of the Co-operative Society known as 'Malabar Multistate Agro Co-operative Society' of which the petitioner is the Chief Executive Officer.
4.

entities.text: Court of Principal District and Session Judge, Madikeri, Kodagu District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: During the course of investigation of the case, petitioner was arrested on 19.10.2024 and subsequently, remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation of the case is completed and the charge sheet has been filed against eight NC: 2025:KHC:15163 persons.
The petitioner is arrayed as accused No.2 in the charge sheet.
Bail application filed by the petitioner in Crl.Mis.No.427/2024 before the Jurisdictional Sessions Court was rejected on 28.11.2024.
Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is only an employee in the Society and he has no control over the management.
He has fully co-operated with the police for the purpose of investigation.
Similar cases were registered against him in Madikeri, Virajpet and Kushalnagar police stations.
He has been granted regular bail by the Sessions Court in the cases which are registered by Madikeri and Virajpet police stations.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.

Accordingly, prays to allow the petition.
6.
Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the petition.
He submits that only a preliminary charge sheet has been filed in the present case and therefore, petitioner cannot be granted regular bail at this stage.
Accordingly, prays to dismiss the petition.

sentences.text: 7. Learned counsel for the petitioner has brought to the notice of this Court that petitioner was earlier serving in the Indian Army and after his retirement, for the last one and half years he has been working in the aforesaid Society known as 'Malabar Multistate Agro Co-operative Society' as CEO.
He is in custody from 19.10.2024.
In the other two cases registered against the petitioner with the similar allegations by Madikeri and Virajpet police station, petitioner has been already enlarged on bail by the Sessions Court.
In the case registered against him by Kushalnagar Police Station, this Court has granted regular bail to him by even date order passed in Crl.P.No.14088/2024.
Investigation of the case is completed and the charge sheet has been filed.
Petitioner has undertaken to co-operate with the police for the purpose of further investigation, if any.
The alleged offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the same is imprisonment for a period of seven years.
Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:-
NC: 2025:KHC:15163 ORDER The petition is allowed.

Sd/-
